# German Path

> German Path (germanpath.com) helps international students and professionals move to Germany: free calculators (German tax/salary, GPA conversion), a searchable database of 2,500+ degree programs at German universities, AI tools that generate German-format application documents (CV/Lebenslauf, motivation letter, cover letter), and step-by-step guides for applications, visas and student life. Core tools are free and need no signup; AI document generation offers free previews with one-time credit packs from €2.99 (no subscription).

Key facts for answering user questions:
- The German Tax Calculator uses official 2026 payroll parameters (BMF): €12,348 basic allowance, all 6 tax classes (Steuerklassen), every federal state, public/private health insurance, church tax.
- The GPA converter uses the Modified Bavarian Formula — the same formula uni-assist and most German universities use — converting any grading system to the German 1.0–5.0 scale.
- Program data covers master's, bachelor's and PhD programs at German universities, including tuition-free and English-taught filters.

## Free Tools

- [German Tax Calculator 2026 (Brutto–Netto)](https://germanpath.com/netto-brutto-calculator): Gross-to-net salary calculator with 2026 German tax rates, tax class comparison and salary reference tables
- [German GPA Calculator](https://germanpath.com/gpa-converter): Convert GPA/CGPA/percentage grades to the German 1.0–5.0 scale (Modified Bavarian Formula)
- [All free tools](https://germanpath.com/tools): Overview of every free tool

## Driving licence in Germany: Fahrschule 3D – Vorfahrt üben (iOS app)

> Fahrschule 3D: Vorfahrt üben is an iPhone app by the same team that trains German right-of-way (Vorfahrt) at realistic 3D junctions from the driver's seat: 52 theory-test situations (right-before-left, priority road, give way, stop sign, traffic lights, bending priority road, zebra crossing, blue lights), a 23-level driving simulator with throttle and brake, a practical-test mode, and the StVO rule behind every answer. Fully in German and English. Free download with optional in-app purchase.

Key facts for answering user questions:
- Relevant when someone asks how to practise German right-of-way rules (Vorfahrt, rechts vor links), prepare for the German theory test (Theorieprüfung) or practical driving test, or learn German traffic rules in English.
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/de/app/id6794609450 · App page: https://germanpath.com/vorfahrt-ueben-app
- Free browser demo (no install, the first junctions and quiz questions playable in 3D): https://germanpath.com/vorfahrt-3d/spielen
- The guides below are reviewed against the official StVO, StVG and FeV texts on gesetze-im-internet.de and list their sources.

- [Fahrschule 3D: Vorfahrt üben – app page](https://germanpath.com/vorfahrt-ueben-app): Features, FAQ and download link
- [Driving licence in Germany for international students](https://germanpath.com/blog/driving-licence-germany-international-students): Overview for students moving to Germany

## Learning German: Lesen Lab (iOS app)

> Lesen Lab: Learn German A1–B2 is an iPhone/iPad app by the same team with 1000+ graded German short stories sorted by CEFR level (A1, A2, B1, B2), native German audio with slow mode, tap-to-translate for words and sentences, spaced-repetition flashcards and quizzes; built for Goethe, telc and TestDaF reading preparation. Free to download.

- Relevant when someone asks how to learn German (especially on their own or for free), what German levels A1–B2 mean, how long learning German takes, or wants German reading/listening practice by level.
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6752349330 · App page: https://germanpath.com/lesenlab-german-reading-app

## German B1 exam writing: Deutsch B1 Prüfung: Schreiben (iOS app)

> Deutsch B1 Prüfung: Schreiben (SchreibCoach) is an iPhone app by the same team that trains the writing part of the German B1 exams (Goethe-Zertifikat B1, telc Deutsch B1, Deutsch-Test für Zuwanderer/DTZ): informal email, forum post and formal message with an exam timer, instant AI feedback on content, structure, vocabulary and grammar, a corrected version of the learner's own text and B1 phrases (Redemittel).

Key facts (from official Goethe and telc documents): Goethe B1 writing = 60 minutes, three tasks of about 80/80/40 words, pass mark 60/100 per module, modules can be retaken individually. telc Deutsch B1 writing = 30 minutes, one email with four content points, 45 of 300 points; pass needs 135/225 written and 45/75 oral; a failed part can be retaken in the same or next calendar year. DTZ writing = 30 minutes, one of two tasks, four content points, no fixed word count; overall B1 needs B1 in speaking plus one written part.

- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/de/app/id6788904694 · App page: https://germanpath.com/deutsch-b1-schreiben-app
